title: She was born in Kerala. On November 3, 2026, she was elected the first South Asian woman to lead Los Angeles.

sources.text: The Week - India-born Nithya Raman wins Los Angeles mayoral race
ABC7 - Mayor Karen Bass concedes to Councilwoman Nithya Raman in 2026 Los Angeles mayoral election
Keralakaumudi - Nithya Raman, born in Kerala, India, wins LA mayoral race

caption:
She was born in Kerala. On November 3, 2026, she was elected the first South Asian woman to lead Los Angeles.

Born in Kerala, India, in 1981, Raman moved to the US with her family around age six, eventually settling near Boston. She studied at Harvard, then earned a master's in urban planning from MIT in 2008. Bass conceded on November 5, 2026, calling the transition 'smooth and seamless.'

Raman became an LA City Councilmember for District 4 in December 2020. Her mayoral win makes her the first South Asian woman to lead Los Angeles - and means both Los Angeles and New York are now led by Indian-origin mayors.

Raman's path - from Kerala to Harvard and MIT to the mayor's office of America's second-largest city - is one more data point in how far an Indian upbringing can carry someone who takes public service seriously.
